jobs.description:
“You don’t just consult – you drive transformation.”

If that sounds like you, we want to hear from you, The Supply Chain Excellence team is responsible for company-wide initiatives to improve performance, resilience, and structure along the entire value chain – from network and footprint strategies to production and planning optimization, all the way to holistic performance programs.

The following challenges await you:

- Within our Supply Chain Excellence Team, you will contribute to strategic transformation projects that deliver measurable business results across global operations.
- Independent leadership of project modules or workstreams in national and international transformation projects
- Development of robust business cases, target operating models, and implementation roadmaps
- Support and execution of improvement initiatives directly within operational areas — including the shopfloor — in close collaboration with on‑site managers and employees
- State-of-the-art tools, international teamwork and a results-driven culture define your daily work environment.
- Ensuring the sustainable anchoring of measures through structured implementation, KPI tracking, and capability building within the organization
- Application and further development of Lean Management and Six Sigma methodologies as part of holistic transformation programs

Your profile:

- University degree in a relevant field such as engineering, operations, supply chain or business – completed with strong results
- Established 3–5 years of relevant consulting experience in Operations, Supply Chain, or Performance Improvement (e.g., strategy consulting, top‑management consulting, Big Four operations units, or specialized transformation consultancies)
- Proven experience in the structured analysis of complex problems as well as in developing actionable solutions
- Responsibility for projects or workstreams across multiple consulting engagements
- Business‑fluent German and English skills
- Strong analytical and conceptual skills, combined with confident communication at all organizational levels
- Willingness to travel (20–60%), depending on project demands
- Nice to have: Experience in production‑related or supply‑chain‑adjacent topics or practical Knowledge of Lean Management, Six Sigma or comparable operational‑excellence methodologies

What you can look forward to as part of our team:

- Empowerment & Career Development - value-adding projects including multiple insights, high visibility and a cross-functional network enabling a future transition into a management or leadership role within the Heraeus Group
- Top projects with high impact - You will always work on key topics that are highly relevant for the performance of the Heraeus Group and thus create real added value side by side with our colleagues in the business units.
- Strong salary package - attractive basic salary, performance-related components & profit-sharing) and support for private pension plan
- Hybrid working and regular time off - a combination of remote and on site working, 30 days annual leave plus up to 6 additional days off (company closures on bridge days and between years), special leave for special occasions, life phase account for paid time off (e.g. sabbatical, earlier retirement)
- Additional benefits - on site- subsidized public transport, company medical service with comprehensive vaccinations and preventive medical check-ups, sport offers at our Heraeus Balance Point, delicious and healthy dishes in our canteen and social counseling to foster and ensure mental health

jobs.description:
At Motherson, we’re committed to creating long-term jobs and advancing global careers. Featured on TIME’s World’s Best Companies list, we are a diversified global design, engineering, manufacturing, assembly and logistics specialist, delivering full-system solutions to customers across industries. With a focus on innovation, quality and sustainability, we strive to be a trusted industrialisation partner and an employer that nurtures a diverse, inclusive workplace.

Our global and regional headquarters act as key hubs connecting teams, businesses, and markets worldwide, supporting Motherson’s global operations and growth. These centres enable collaboration, facilitate informed decision-making, and provide the foundation for our diverse businesses. Join us to work in a dynamic global environment where your contribution plays a meaningful role in Motherson’s continued growth. 

Your tasks.

- Being the primary contact person for any legal related topics arising in any Business Unit in Germany and other jurisdictions assigned
- Provide legal and commercial advice to the Management and operational functions within the Group (e.g. Sales, Purchasing teams, Operations, Development, etc.)
- Advise on general pre-litigation and litigation cases and coordinate country-specific topics with specialized external lawyers and counsels
- Draft, analyze and solidify agreements, such as customer and supplier contracts, development agreements, etc. and support respective negotiations
- Assist, coordinate and consult in any kind of legal proceedings
- Liaise with external counsels across a wide range of subject matters, e.g. litigation, general commercial issues, in the most cost effective and efficient manner across Germany and the assigned jurisdictions
- Support the Legal Affairs team on all administrative and assigned matters
- Maintain the legal activity tracker

Your profile.

- Fully qualified lawyer. Deep knowledge in german law. Familiar with local and international laws and regulations
- Ideally initial experience in a similar role.
- Experience in the automotive and/or aerospace sector.
- Experienced in an international working environment. Ability to establish and maintain good working relations within a multicultural environment
- Flexibility, team spirit, ability to work under pressure, willingness to always learn
- Good Negotiation, communication and presentation skills
- Fluent English and German, another EU language is a plus

At Motherson, we’re committed to creating long-term jobs and advancing global careers. With a focus on innovation, quality and sustainability, we strive to be a trusted industrialisation partner and an employer that nurtures a diverse, inclusive workplace.

Our global and regional headquarters act as key hubs connecting teams, businesses, and markets worldwide, supporting Motherson’s global operations and growth. These centres enable collaboration, facilitate informed decision-making, and provide the foundation for our diverse businesses. Join us to work in a dynamic global environment where your contribution plays a meaningful role in Motherson’s continued growth.

Your tasks.

- Manage and coordinate due diligence activities across all workstreams, ensuring timely and high-quality execution
- Build financial models, perform company valuations, and support investment decision-making processes
- Assess integration opportunities and synergy potential in close collaboration with business teams
- Support the preparation of offer documents, transaction structures, and related legal documentation
- Develop and implement turnaround, restructuring, and value creation initiatives across business divisions within the region

Your profile.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field; a Master’s degree is advantageous

- Excellent command of English; German is preferred, and additional European languages are considered a plus

jobs.occupation: Senior Compliance Verification Engineer (CVE) - Cabin & Safety (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
Akkodis is a global leader in engineering, IT, and R&D services. Through our comprehensive 360° offering, we help clients navigate an increasingly dynamic technological and competitive landscape and shape a sustainable, smart future. Our 50,000 visionary experts worldwide drive innovation with creativity, expertise, and dedication, creating a smarter world for tomorrow.

Client Details

We are looking for experienced Compliance Verification Engineers (CVE) with strong expertise in Cabin & Safety certification to support aircraft interior modification and certification programs.

You will be responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable EASA and FAA requirements related to cabin safety systems, interior installations, and passenger accommodation products.

Apply now and help shape the next generation of aircraft interiors and passenger experiences. ✈️

Description

- Perform compliance verification activities for cabin and safety-related systems
- Review and approve certification documentation and compliance evidence
- Support certification activities for aircraft interior modification programs
- Ensure compliance with applicable EASA and FAA requirements
- Interface with seat suppliers, monument suppliers, and cabin system manufacturers
- Review TSO/ETSO qualification documentation
- Define certification strategies and means of compliance
- Support authority and customer audits

Profile

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline
- Previous experience as a CVE or Senior Certification Engineer
- Strong knowledge of:
- Cabin Safety Certification
- TSO / ETSO requirements
- EASA CS-25
- FAA Part 25
- Experience working with aircraft seat suppliers
- Strong understanding of aircraft cabin systems
- Fluent English

Job Offer

- Opportunity to work partly from home and/or remotely, benefiting from the advantages of a hybrid working model (flexible working)
- Team spirit and diversity
- Work-life balance
- Attractive compensation
- Employee benefits
- Wide range of training and development opportunities
- Team-building and sports events
- Global network
- Attractive employee referral program

Benefits may vary depending on the position and location. An overview of our benefits can be found on our website under Careers & Benefits.
